page_title: SWI 4-1 BOS | Switzerland v Bosnia & Herzegovina 18/06/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+7' 4 - 1 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Granit Xhaka (Switzerland) low into the right of the net, giving goalkeeper Nikola Vasilj no chance!
90+7' Granit Xhaka (Switzerland) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.

90+7' Amar Memic (Bosnia & Herzegovina) commits a minor foul to interrupt the attacking move of his opponent and is warned by the referee that he will get a yellow card if he does it again. Switzerland are awarded a penalty!

90+3' 3 - 1 Ermin Mahmic (Bosnia & Herzegovina) gets to the ball on the edge of the box and fires in a first-time shot without any hesitation. The strike is excellent and goes straight under the crossbar. He couldn't have done it any better. 3:1.
90+3' Amir Hadziahmetovic (Bosnia & Herzegovina) takes the corner kick, but Gregor Kobel reads it well and stops the effort.
90+1' Here is a change. Kerim Alajbegovic is going off and Sergej Barbarez gives the last tactical orders to Ermin Mahmic (Bosnia & Herzegovina).
90' 6 additional min. will be played.

90' 3 - 0 Goal! Ruben Vargas plays in Johan Manzambi (Switzerland), who shows great determination to get to the ball before a couple of defenders and from inside the box slots it into the bottom right corner 3:0.
89' Cedric Itten (Switzerland) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Breel Embolo.
88' Ruben Vargas (Switzerland) tries to find Breel Embolo, but he puts too much power on the pass.
86' The manager makes a subsitution with Amir Hadziahmetovic (Bosnia & Herzegovina) coming on for Ivan Sunjic.
86' Murat Yakin prepares a substitution. Silvan Widmer is replaced by Luca Jaquez (Switzerland).
86' Substitution. Jovo Lukic (Bosnia & Herzegovina) in, Ermedin Demirovic out.
84' 2 - 0 Goal! Breel Embolo plays a simple square pass into the feet of Ruben Vargas (Switzerland) in the box, who composes himself and lashes the ball into the bottom right corner. 2:0.
82' Ruben Vargas (Switzerland) whips in a cross from the corner, but Nikola Vasilj is well positioned and punches the ball away.
82' Ruben Vargas (Switzerland) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, sending it towards the right post only for Nikola Vasilj to dive and make a save.
81' Switzerland earn a free kick which could lead to a goal-scoring opportunity.
80' Tarik Muharemovic (Bosnia & Herzegovina) reacts stupidly and the referee shows him a deserved red card!
78' The attendance for today's match is 70026.
74' 1 - 0 Goal! Johan Manzambi (Switzerland) fires the rebound inside the right post after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 1:0.
71' The match can continue after the interruption.
71' Substitution. Michel Aebischer makes way for Djibril Sow (Switzerland).
71' Murat Yakin decides to make a substitution. Fabian Rieder will be replaced by Ruben Vargas (Switzerland).
71' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Dan Ndoye leaves the pitch and Johan Manzambi (Switzerland) comes on.
69' It’s hot out there so the ref signals there will be a cooling break for the players to take on some fluids.

69' Amar Dedic (Bosnia & Herzegovina) gets into a good scoring position. He creates some space for himself and tries his luck from distance. His decent effort towards the middle of the goal is, however, saved by Gregor Kobel!
68' Sead Kolasinac (Bosnia & Herzegovina) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
67' Sead Kolasinac (Bosnia & Herzegovina) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
65' Nico Elvedi (Switzerland) is punished with the yellow card.
64' Sergej Barbarez has decided to substitute Edin Dzeko and he is replaced by Esmir Bajraktarevic (Bosnia & Herzegovina).
63' A substitution has been made. Benjamin Tahirovic goes off and Ivan Basic (Bosnia & Herzegovina) comes on.
63' Breel Embolo (Switzerland) launches into a thunderous tackle on his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
63' After some poor defending, Breel Embolo (Switzerland) gets to a rebound and plants a header towards the left side of the goal, but Nikola Vasilj dives to stop the effort. Brilliant goalkeeping!
62' Switzerland have been awarded a corner kick.
62' Fabian Rieder (Switzerland) once again attempts to send a defence-splitting pass, but the opposition's defence is alert and intercepts the ball.
61' Edin Dzeko (Bosnia & Herzegovina) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card.
59' Amar Dedic (Bosnia & Herzegovina) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Joao Pinheiro ignores the protests.
57' The linesman signals that Dan Ndoye (Switzerland) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
55' Michel Aebischer (Switzerland) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.

55' Dan Ndoye (Switzerland) collects a pass from the flank, looks up and fires in a goal-bound shot from the edge of the box which canons off a defender to safety. The ball goes out of play. Switzerland are awarded a corner kick.
53' Michel Aebischer (Switzerland) leaps high to meet a lofted pass inside the six-yard box, but his header flies yards wide of the right post.
51' Dan Ndoye (Switzerland) picks up a pass and has an effort from the edge of the box, but Nikola Vasilj gets down to his right to keep it out.
50' Breel Embolo (Switzerland) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The ball goes out of play and Bosnia & Herzegovina will have a goal kick.
47' Granit Xhaka (Switzerland) brings his opponent down. Joao Pinheiro has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul.
46' Joao Pinheiro blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+4' The match has reached half-time.
45+2' Flag up against Ermedin Demirovic (Bosnia & Herzegovina). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
45' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.
45' Kerim Alajbegovic (Bosnia & Herzegovina) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.

44' Sead Kolasinac (Bosnia & Herzegovina) passes the ball from the edge of the box in order to find his teammate, who is in a good scoring position, but the defender blocks the pass and spanks the ball to safety. The linesman makes the right call and Bosnia & Herzegovina will have a corner.
41' Edin Dzeko (Bosnia & Herzegovina) gets on the end of a pass and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players.
38' Amar Dedic (Bosnia & Herzegovina) had a good opportunity from long range. His shot was directed towards the bottom left corner, but Gregor Kobel was alert and made a comfortable save.
36' Michel Aebischer (Switzerland) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.
36' Breel Embolo (Switzerland) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. Switzerland get a corner.
35' The ball possession at the moment is 71:29.
32' A pass by Edin Dzeko (Bosnia & Herzegovina) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
28' Granit Xhaka (Switzerland) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Nikola Vasilj comes off the line to clear the ball away.
26' The game gets underway again after that interruption.
23' It’s time for the cooling break for the players to take on some fluids. It’s hot out there!
23' Remo Freuler (Switzerland) tries his luck and hits a thunderbolt of a shot towards goal from long range, but his powerful strike goes narrowly wide of the left post.

20' Dan Ndoye (Switzerland) superbly controls a difficult pass on the edge of the box and effortlessly let's fly with a magnificent low strike towards the middle of the goal, which the keeper somehow pushes away.
20' Remo Freuler (Switzerland) clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of Silvan Widmer, but he can't get on the end of the pass.
16' The foul by Dan Ndoye (Switzerland) was seen by Joao Pinheiro who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
13' Fabian Rieder (Switzerland) sends a pass into the box, but the opposition's defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance.
11' Breel Embolo (Switzerland) is deemed to be in an offside position by the linesman and it looks like it is the right decision despite being a very close call.
10' Dan Ndoye (Switzerland) drives into the box and hits a tremendous shot that, unluckily for him, flashes just wide of the left post.
8' Fabian Rieder (Switzerland) takes a short corner kick.
8' Granit Xhaka (Switzerland) unleashes a missile of a shot towards goal, but his good effort is blocked by one of the defenders. The ball is out of play and Switzerland manage to earn a corner.
7' Michel Aebischer (Switzerland) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.
6' The corner from Michel Aebischer (Switzerland) is cleared away by the defence.

6' Ricardo Rodriguez (Switzerland) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort. It will be a corner kick for Switzerland.
4' The game is interrupted as Breel Embolo (Switzerland) is flagged offside.
2' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Bosnia & Herzegovina.

2' The free kick is delivered by Kerim Alajbegovic (Bosnia & Herzegovina) but it's not one of his best and is easily cleared. The referee blows his whistle, Bosnia & Herzegovina are awarded a corner kick.
1' Michel Aebischer (Switzerland) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Joao Pinheiro signals. Bosnia & Herzegovina win a free kick.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are on the pitch and Bosnia & Herzegovina will have the kick-off.
Joao Pinheiro was nominated as the referee for this game.
